messages:
maria: Canary rollout blocked — saw two OOMs in canary after today's runtime merge (commit 3f8c9b). Repro on instance rwd-canary-3.
ken: ack. seeing same in prod-canary-2. stack traces point at kv_cache::alloc_slab during compaction.
linh: perf-ci triggered a regression alert on the nightly perf-run: 15% higher p95 mem for longctx workloads. Tagging @perf-ci
perf-ci: nightly/perf-run failed: mem-usage p95 increased from 1.2GB -> 1.38GB on gpu-x86 tests. Noted correlation with "allocator:coalesce=true" flag flip in 3f8c9b.
junaid: logs from canary:
```
runtime.ERROR kv_cache: failed to allocate slab: requested=5242880 available=0
stack: kv_cache::alloc_slab+0x2f
         compactor::merge_chunks+0x1a3
         worker::process_batch+0x4c
```
maria: looks like fragmentation — normal for large seq_len runs. But these are short-seq inference jobs too.
ken: I ran heap profile on a repro build. Snapshot shows many small free fragments but huge unusable gaps — allocator failing to coalesce across mmap boundaries after that kernel-selection change.
linh: Which merge introduced the change? 3f8c9b touched kernel selector + allocator hints; 3f8d4e touched batching heuristics but not allocator.
maria: bisect plan: revert 3f8c9b locally and run canary. If that fixes, open emergency revert PR. Who can run? @ken can you? :pray:
ken: starting revert test now, building debug image.
ops-bot: deploys: canary-deploy/2026-03-18-12: queued -> in_progress
ken: quick mitigation: lowering kv_cache.max_seq_len from 4096 -> 1024 reduces mem pressure, temporary canary pass in my local run. But this degrades throughput for longctx customers.
junaid: another quick patch: disable allocator coalescing flag (allocator.coalesce=false) in runtime config. That also stops OOMs in canary.
maria: prefer revert of 3f8c9b as source fix. If revert takes longer, ship config patch to disable coalescing as emergency workaround and notify customers.
perf-ci: perf build finished for revert candidate: mem p95 back to 1.21GB, latency unchanged. Looks promising.
ken: canary with revert applied is green for 10 minutes, no OOM. opening revert PR now: PR#5821
maria: great. tagging eng-runtime on the PR and scheduling a short postmortem to root cause the allocator/kernel selector interaction. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
